targetAudience.primary: Architects of enterprise agent platforms, managed configuration and policy-governed tool access
targetAudience.knowledgeAssumption: The reader understands caches, remote policy and fail-closed authorization.
targetAudience.readerProblem: A cache layer can preserve availability by returning stale configuration even after the governing authority may have changed, silently turning readable data into continuing permission.

whyNow: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.81 documents a forced-refresh path that rejects both the normal cache fast path and a 24-hour stale fallback, restricting named capabilities until fresh managed policy is obtained.

externalHook.description: A product release contract distinguishes cached policy availability from admissible current authority.

coreProposition: When current remote authority is explicitly required, stale cached policy may remain stored evidence but must not retain authorization power; the runtime should represent unresolved freshness as an explicit restrictive authority state with named affected capabilities and recovery conditions.

originalValue.description: Reframes freshness from a cache optimization into part of the authorization predicate and models unresolved authority as a bounded governed state rather than a generic fetch failure.

readerTakeaway: Keep cached policy for evidence and diagnosis, but require an explicit current-authority decision before it grants capabilities; record which capabilities are restricted, why, and what event restores eligibility.

supported: The official changelog says the forced-refresh path rejects the one-hour fast path and 24-hour stale fallback.
Named policy-governed capabilities enter a restrictive posture while fresh managed policy is unresolved.
The restrictive condition ends after fresh managed policy is successfully fetched.
unsupported: The undisclosed freshness key, transport authentication or response-validation implementation
All capabilities or all policy-refresh paths
uncertain: How revision, account and organization identity define freshness
How already-running governed capabilities react mid-session
The operational availability cost of strict freshness

firstPartyRole.rationale: The article develops a general enterprise authority-freshness pattern without a first-party project mapping.

decisionReason: The official product contract supports a concrete stale-authority boundary and a useful architectural distinction while the article explicitly preserves implementation uncertainty.
